pins.name: D8
pins.label: D8 (GPIO8)
pins.notes: Shared TMC2209 UART TX (TX4) - all four onboard stepper drivers (X/Y/Z/E0) multi-drop off this single line via per-driver UART address. Was previously exposed as plain D8 (full digital I/O) due to a static-const alias in pins_arduino.h; corrected here - driving this pin generically would corrupt every driver's UART configuration.
